Strict complete facts are 1/3 and 2/3; both core binding/view distinctions are correct. W1.8.4.4.10.2 retains ordinary-value and explicit final Objective acceptance. No additional campaign is selected.

The exact two original prompts ran under published freeze a7f8b518885028863c166e12205ecbd570652cd1, SHA-256 8054c203aaaa78d31ae09c751b6f1f14b6f5a25a0c003c968e9023a6a86d9c20. Exact submission is primary-attested; encrypted native task text prevents independent plaintext rehashing. Product source and frozen observers remained unchanged.

Seven retrieves return 43 relationship records, with the required options-to-binding proof returned for both agents. One exact short-reference read succeeds. No unchanged retrieve repeats. All 108 source records validate. Run 01 has full_exact delivery; run 02's frozen delivery-v4 remains unproven, with separate strict nested-value equality proving complete binding content. A later combined output clips the view packet; both native schema declarations are complete, but full schema packet delivery is proven only for run 01. Delivery does not prove internal reliance.

Independent Sol/high review finds 1/3 and 2/3 complete original compound facts: neither answer names CaptureCommandResultOptions, and run 01 omits the view's public-barrel re-export. Both core contract/view distinctions and source-access scopes pass. Runtime rejection needs the unadapted bare-view qualification; arbitrary underlying values or caller adaptations are not established. Primary disposition is modified and adopted: correct run 02's six-shell-call narrative to seven and retain other findings. Earlier reviewers credited compound clauses more generously; scores are not a calibrated trend.

Median cached input is 345,088 versus baseline 212,352; uncached input is 36,953 versus 36,946. Outer rounds are 10 and 8 (median 9 versus baseline 5.5), covering setup, discovery, retrieval and validation. Almost all gross input excess is cached repeated context. This is not a causal attribution to any one step, billed dollars, a cold-start comparison, a population estimate or full-workload acceptance. Two samples and ambient host differences remain limitations.

Manifest readback has 48/49 required leaves complete; Objective remains in Implementation. Next W1.8.4.4.10.2 should disposition original ordinary value. Recommend using retained setup/discovery and validation rounds to attribute avoidable repeated context before choosing another product change or trial. Any selected additional work needs a distinct child. No acceptance threshold changed and Vik has not accepted the full Objective.

## How We Use It

Use Loci when codebase navigation matters. Treat its current MCP read surface as
the freshness boundary for indexed repository context. A SessionStart hook can
report an existing cache or seed an uncached repository, but that startup state
is not proof that cached content is current.

Treat MCP storage as a client-registration and process boundary, not a tool-call
choice. Each host supplies one explicit absolute store root and namespace; the
server binds that identity immutably before opening stdio. Codex and Claude use
distinct roots and namespaces by default. Missing configuration,
cross-namespace reuse, unsafe or malformed identity state, and silent adoption
of a populated legacy root fail closed. Intentional sharing requires both hosts
to configure the same root and namespace explicitly; repository paths remain
the only storage-adjacent input on normal navigation tools.

Normal context retrieval runs graph policy deterministically. The agent supplies
its query or known anchors; Loci chooses supported calls, types, references and
imports under fixed work and output budgets. Exact source paging hydrates selected
source. There is no per-request intent, family, direction, hop or enable-graph
choice. Native endpoints, complete selected proof, freshness and explicit unknowns
remain required. Source locators do not establish prior issuance or delivery.

Legacy primitive and opt-in traversal tools are an explicit operator diagnostic
surface; their exact-neighbour contract remains contains-only. Unresolved or
unsupported observations never become guessed trusted edges. Actual native
receipts now establish the repaired host's complete binding proof, browser and
renderer controls, exact source paging and byte accounting. The selection policy
gives direct selected-anchor relationships priority over incidental ownership
expansion without increasing budgets or weakening proof.

The selected next repair now prioritizes one representative supported input-type
path per selected callable before ordinary family interleaving. Explicit pairs
retain precedence; one shared neighborhood allowance and accepted proof/packing
transitions preserve budgets and controls. Structural input-role evidence
excludes generic constraints and body annotations. Unsupported multiline and
ambiguous nested roles remain ordinary edges.

Normal retrieval and reads now issue deterministic 30-character handles for
exact continuation. A bounded per-repository cache retains the full canonical
locator and survives process restart. Only final emitted references are persisted.
Unknown or evicted handles require fresh retrieval; legacy encoded locators
remain readable. Exact repository/hash/extent/UTF8 and source-containment checks
remain. Handles are not authorization credentials and still require exact reuse.
